legal.about_tagline: A shared calendar, made for families.
legal.about_what_body: Family Agenda is a mobile app that helps families organize their daily schedules. Each family member can have their own shifts, tasks and appointments, all visible on a single shared calendar.
legal.about_feat_1: Monthly, weekly and daily shared calendar
legal.about_feat_2: Customizable shifts per member (morning, afternoon, night, off, etc.)
legal.about_feat_6: Notifications for recent changes in the next 14 days
legal.about_privacy_body: Your family data is stored in an isolated database with Row Level Security policies ensuring only members of your family have access. We do not sell or share personal data with third parties.
legal.about_contact_body: Questions, issues or suggestions? Send us an email:
legal.about_delete_body: You can delete your account at any time from the app settings.
legal.terms_1_body: By installing, accessing or using the Family Agenda application ("the App"), the user agrees to these Terms of Use and to the Privacy Policy described in this document. If you do not agree, you must stop using the App.
legal.terms_2_body: Family Agenda is a mobile app for organizing schedules and tasks among members of the same family. It allows creating accounts, creating or joining a family, managing shifts, tasks and inviting other members by email.
legal.terms_3_body_1: To use the App you need to create an account with a valid email and password. The user is responsible for keeping the credentials confidential and for all actions performed with their account.
legal.terms_3_body_2: Only the family owner can remove other members. The user can delete their own account at any time from the "Settings" screen.
legal.terms_4_intro: We collect only the data needed to provide the service:
legal.terms_4_2: Family and member names (defined by you)
legal.terms_4_3: Shifts, schedule types and tasks you create
legal.terms_4_5: Date and time of record creation/modification
legal.terms_4_no: We do not collect location data, contacts, camera, microphone, or advertising identifiers.
legal.terms_5_1: For authentication and to keep you signed in
legal.terms_5_2: To display the shared calendar to family members
legal.terms_5_3: To send invitation emails (only when you invite someone)
legal.terms_5_4: To improve service stability and security
legal.terms_5_no_sell: We do not sell, rent, or share personal data with third parties for advertising purposes.
legal.terms_6_body_1: Data is stored in a PostgreSQL database managed by Supabase Inc. (EU-West). We apply Row Level Security policies ensuring each user can only see their own family's data.
legal.terms_6_body_2: Invitation emails are sent via the Resend service. Emails are deleted from our systems after 30 days.
legal.terms_7_body: Data is kept while your account is active. When you delete your account, all associated data is deleted within a maximum of 30 days.
legal.terms_8_1: Access your data directly in the App
legal.terms_8_3: Delete your account and data (Settings → Delete Account)
legal.terms_8_4: Request a copy of your data by email
legal.terms_9_body: The App is intended for users at least 16 years old. If you are a parent and your child uses the App, you are responsible for their use.
legal.terms_10_body: The App is provided "as is". We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability or absence of errors. We are not liable for indirect losses resulting from the use or inability to use the App.
legal.terms_11_body: We may update these Terms periodically. The last update date is shown at the top. Significant changes will be communicated via in-app notification.
legal.terms_12_body: For any questions regarding these Terms or your privacy:
legal.delete_hero_title: You can delete your account at any time
legal.delete_hero_subtitle: There are two options: inside the App or by email.
legal.delete_opt1_s4: Scroll to the Danger Zone section
legal.delete_opt1_s6: Confirm — your account is deleted immediately
legal.delete_opt2_body_1: If you can't access the App, send us an email from your account address with subject "Delete account" to:
legal.delete_opt2_body_2: We will process your request within a maximum of 30 days and send an email confirmation.
legal.delete_what_2: Members you created (if you are the family owner)
legal.delete_what_3: Shifts, schedule types and tasks you created
legal.delete_retain_body: For legal or security reasons, we may retain some data for a limited period:
legal.delete_retain_1: Anonymous access logs (up to 90 days, for fraud detection)
legal.delete_retain_2: Billing records (not applicable — we don't handle payments)
legal.delete_retain_note: This data cannot identify you personally after deletion.
legal.delete_owner_title: If you are the family owner
legal.delete_owner_body_1: If you are the family owner, deleting your account deletes the entire family and all associated data — including other members' schedules and tasks.
legal.delete_owner_body_2: Alternative: you can transfer ownership to another member before deleting, or unlink yourself from the family.
legal.delete_deadline_body: Data is deleted from our systems immediately upon confirmation. Backup copies are automatically deleted within a maximum of 30 days.
